rebaseline_reason: Sequences 827-1003 include 65 rows whose entry_hash was computed over a Python negative zero that Postgres NUMERIC normalises away, so those rows cannot reproduce their own digest. All 65 are FSLR rows with a zero gross return, across 3 signals, with no unexplained residual; every prev_hash link still holds, so the damage is a sparse set and not a broken suffix. The table is append-only by trigger; the rows are frozen as written and are not edited. Verification of the live record restarts at this sequence, anchored on the frozen prefix's head. The write-path fix went live in 3480659 on 2026-09-07 and 1004 is the first row written after it. See docs/specs/2026-09-06-ledger-rebaseline.md.
